definitions.explanation: A container or rack for storing umbrellas, typically placed near the entrance of buildings or homes.

examples.japanese: {傘|かさ}は{入|い}り{口|ぐち}の{傘立|かさた}てに{入|い}れてください。
examples.english: Please put your umbrella in the umbrella stand at the entrance.

examples.japanese: {傘立|かさた}てから{自分|じぶん}の{傘|かさ}を{取|と}って{出|で}た。
examples.english: I took my umbrella from the umbrella stand and left.

examples.japanese: {玄関|げんかん}に{傘立|かさた}てを{置|お}いている。
examples.english: We have an umbrella stand at the entrance.

notes:
FORMATION:
{傘|かさ} (umbrella) + {立|た}て (stand, from {立|た}てる)

Literally 'umbrella stand.'

COLLOCATIONS:
・{傘立|かさた}てに{入|い}れる - to put in the umbrella stand
・{傘立|かさた}てから{取|と}る - to take from the umbrella stand
・{玄関|げんかん}の{傘立|かさた}て - umbrella stand at the entrance

CULTURAL NOTE:
{傘立|かさた}て are very common in Japan, found at the entrance of most buildings, stores, and homes. Many public places provide them to prevent wet umbrellas from being brought inside. Some places have umbrella locks ({傘|かさ}ロック) to prevent theft.
